layer_contract.F.Cu: primary components plus USB/MIPI/QSPI/SDIO critical routing
layer_contract.In1.Cu: unbroken solid GND reference plane; no split under critical routes
layer_contract.In2.Cu: power distribution and low-speed routing only where return-path continuity is preserved
layer_contract.B.Cu: secondary low-speed routing/components; no primary USB/MIPI unless a separately recalculated reference strategy is approved

USB0_HS.screening_source: current JITX JLC04161H_7628 library publishes DRS_90 on outer layer with 0.2332 mm width and 0.15 mm pair spacing; public JLC calculator examples differ with selected spacing/soldermask assumptions

MIPI_DSI.screening_source: current JITX JLC04161H_7628 library publishes DRS_100 on outer layer with 0.1722 mm width and 0.15 mm pair spacing

required_before_lock: record current JLCPCB impedance-calculator result for JLC04161H-7628, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, F.Cu referenced to In1.Cu
record exact selected trace width and edge-to-edge pair gap for 90 ohm and 100 ohm classes
confirm soldermask/model option used by the fabrication order
apply the exact values to KiCad net classes/custom rules and DRC them
preserve the selected JLC stackup in fabrication notes
production_impedance_gate.rule: Screening values may be used for placement/channel budgeting, but no release Gerber may be called impedance-controlled until the direct JLC calculator record is committed.

USB0_HS: J2 -> D2 ESD -> series elements -> U1 with no stubs
USB1_FS: J3 -> D3 ESD -> optional tuning network -> U1 with symmetric pair geometry
MIPI_DSI: U1 -> six inline 0R tuning footprints -> J6
zero-ohm footprints stay inline with no tee stubs
if a layer transition becomes unavoidable add adjacent GND return vias and recalculate geometry
P4_QSPI: U2 and series tuning elements form a compact U1-local island
clock/data remain short over continuous GND
C6_SDIO: U4 remains close enough for compact SDIO escape
preserve antenna keepout on every copper layer
MICROSD: J7/U13 bus and power-switch cluster stays in lower-right media domain
do not route through FFC mechanical corridor
AUDIO: U5/output RC network in quiet zone
MAIN_L/MAIN_R stay away from switch nodes and USB high-current return bottlenecks
